title: Book Generation Workflow
description: Interactive visualization showing the workflow for generating intelligent textbooks
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: workflow
book generation
intelligent textbooks
process visualization
learningObjectives: Sequence the pipeline stages for generating an intelligent textbook: course description, Bloom's Taxonomy alignment, concept enumeration, concept dependencies, and learning graph
Explain how a learning graph of concept dependencies orders content so foundational concepts precede advanced topics
Identify the book-level and chapter-level outputs (glossary, FAQ, chapters, figures, MicroSims, assessments) that a learning graph powers
Describe the role of the 2001 Bloom's Taxonomy in categorizing a course's learning objectives across six cognitive levels
Distinguish concept enumeration (listing what students must master) from concept dependency mapping (ordering how they learn it)
